q: 1. ............. maximum tangents can be drawn from an outside point on a circle.
explain: From any point located outside a circle, exactly two distinct tangent lines can be drawn to the circle, touching it at two separate points.

q: 2. The paper size of A4 is .............
explain: The standard ISO A4 paper size is 210 mm × 297 mm, the most commonly used sheet size for general documents and smaller drawings.

q: 3. Title block in drawing sheets gives the information about .............
explain: The title block consolidates key reference information — drawing title, scale, drawing number, and other details — making 'all of these' the correct comprehensive answer.

q: 4. Working drawings are prepared at the stage of .............
explain: Working drawings, containing full dimensions and construction details, are produced during the detail design stage, after the concept has been finalized and before construction execution.

q: 5. Concept drawing is normally provided for the work of .............
explain: A concept drawing represents the initial design idea and is prepared before construction begins, to communicate and finalize the overall design intent.
